text:
frida: quick sync notes from today's design pass on Autoscale panel — need alignment so eng can scope. items: guardrail tone, burst pill defaults, adaptive thresholds, pool-picker keyboard trap, aria-live text. figma: https://figma.redwood/infer/autoscale/ux-pass-5
omar: my take: default guardrail should be advisory language for self-serve. 'Recommended cap' reads better. we can surface 'Safety cap' in admin mode. :+1:
tess: Agree on friendly default. Microcopy suggestion (short):
Min: Minimum GPUs kept online to meet latency targets.
Max: Upper bound for scaling during spikes; may increase cost.
Guardrail (recommended): Helps keep traffic within your SLO; excess may be routed to fallback capacity.
leon: Burst pill: propose new adaptive thresholds: pool <=3 show absolute primary; 4-10 show absolute + muted percent; >10 show percent primary with muted absolute on hover. Mobile: single-line percent preferred.
frida: New thresholds sound reasonable and different enough from other drafts. let's test small pools UX separately — +1 for showing absolute on <=3 so users see concrete numbers.
omar: accessibility: current orange marker fails AA on helper text. suggest darker marker #7A3D00 and 2px focus ring. also add aria-live region for slider changes: "Min set to X GPUs. Max set to Y GPUs. Guardrail recommended at Z GPUs." keep messages short and polite.
tess: keyboard trap still an issue in pool-picker because virtualization re-renders the list. implement roving tabindex + aria-activedescendant. Escape must close and return focus to toggle. also show tiny hint under control: "\u2191\u2193 preview \u2022 Enter select \u2022 Esc close" (short and translatable).
frida: analytics asks: please emit events burst_pill_hover, burst_label_primary_toggled, guardrail_info_opened, pool_picker_hint_shown. want to see which representation users prefer.
leon: copy nit: replace 'routed to fallback capacity' with 'sent to fallback capacity' for simpler translation. tess: agree?
tess: yes shorter verbs help l10n. i'll file note. ux-bot: Filed ACC-7901: autoscale-guardrail-contrast + ACC-7902: pool-picker-roving-tabindex. INF-4230 created for analytics events. links in tracker.
frida: one more a11y detail: when guardrail crosses max, announce kindly: "Guardian threshold set above maximum; bursts may be limited." avoid alarm words like 'throttle'.
omar: UI: burst pill compact variant idea: two-line default (bold absolute, muted percent below) for 4-10 pools; >10 percent-primary single line. hover expands with tooltip: "This is temporary additional capacity applied during spikes."
leon: small UX idea: when user drags slider, show ephemeral microcopy under slider: "Estimated cost change: ~+0.3%" — needs eng hook to compute but reduces surprises.
frida: ok next steps: frida will update figma with thresholds and copy, tess will validate roving tabindex prototype, omar will check color contrast and aria-live phrasing, leon will add analytic spec. i'll post updated frames and reopen thread. thanks all :white_check_mark:
